$comment: 听力训练营 L24（P-L3 续跑，阶段三第四课）。脚本 100% 原创；Part 3 观点直说（一段长对话 5 题：觉得电影怎么样 / 觉得座位怎么样 / 对票价什么感受 / 为什么不要爆米花 / 为什么想去电影院看下一部）+ Part 5 匹配直给（Mia 告诉爸爸五个朋友来家里看电影各带什么吃的，8 种食物 A-H 全部被提到，3 个是干扰）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: After the Film
intro: 先听 Mia 和 Jake 看完电影后聊感受：电影好不好看、座位舒不舒服、票价贵不贵？题目问的是「觉得怎么样」「什么感受」「为什么」，注意有些看法是别人的（姐姐说、爸爸说、哥哥说），题目问的是说话人自己。再听 Mia 告诉爸爸周六来家里看电影的五个朋友各带什么吃的，把人和食物配起来——8 种食物都会被提到，有 3 种没人带。

sections.intro: 听 Mia 和 Jake 看完电影后聊感受。五道题问的是看法和理由，注意分清「别人说」和「我觉得」。

script.text: So, Jake, what did you think of the film?
My sister told me it was too long, but I didn't think so. I laughed from the start to the end. The ending was a little sad, but I loved it.
Me too. And I thought the seats were really comfortable. We were near the front, but I like being close to the screen.
My dad says the seats there are too small, but he's very tall. They were fine for me.
Did you know the tickets are eight pounds now? My brother got really angry about that last month.
Eight? I'm not angry. It's a good cinema and I'm happy to pay. But I was surprised. I thought they were still five pounds.
They went up in the summer.
Next time I'll buy the popcorn. Do you want some?
No, thanks. It's not the price, I just don't like the smell of it. I had a big lunch today, but I could still eat some ice cream.
Ice cream, then. What about the next film? It comes out next month.
We could watch it at my house. My TV is big, and it's cheaper. And it's more fun with friends on the sofa.
Friends are nice, but what I really like about the cinema is the sound. It's so loud you can feel it. My TV works fine, but it just isn't the same.
OK, the cinema, then. I'll ask Mum for the money tonight.

questions.q: What did Jake think of the film?
questions.explain: I laughed from the start to the end——他从头笑到尾。「太长」是姐姐说的，他 didn't think so；「有点伤感」只是结尾，he loved it。

questions.q: What does Mia think about the seats?
options: They are too near the screen.
questions.explain: I thought the seats were really comfortable——她觉得舒服。「太小」是 Jake 爸爸说的；「离屏幕近」她说 I like being close to the screen，是喜欢不是抱怨。

questions.q: How does Jake feel about the price of the tickets?
questions.explain: I was surprised. I thought they were still five pounds——他很吃惊。「生气」的是 Mia 的哥哥，Jake 说 I'm not angry；「乐意付钱」他说了，但题目问对价格的感受，重点是 surprised。

questions.q: Why doesn't Mia want any popcorn?
options: She has already eaten a lot.
questions.explain: It's not the price, I just don't like the smell of it——她不喜欢爆米花的味道。价钱她说不是原因；午饭吃得多但还能吃冰淇淋，说明不是吃饱了。

questions.q: Why does Jake want to see the next film at the cinema?
options: He wants to be with friends.
questions.explain: what I really like about the cinema is the sound. It's so loud you can feel it——真正喜欢的是音效。他的电视 works fine 没坏；「和朋友一起」是 Mia 说在家看的好处。

sections.intro: 听 Mia 告诉爸爸周六来家里看电影的五个朋友各带什么吃的。把每个人和右边 A-H 的食物配起来。8 种食物都会被提到，有 3 种没人带——注意听「最后带的是什么」。

script.text: Mia, how many friends are coming to your film night on Saturday? And what are they bringing?
Five, Dad, and Jake. Don't worry, nobody's bringing chocolate. I know you don't want it on the new sofa.
Good. So who's bringing what?
Ella is bringing popcorn. Her mum has a machine that makes it, so it'll be warm.
Nice. And Noah? He always eats a lot.
He wanted to bring ice cream, but there's no room in our fridge. So he's bringing a pizza from his uncle's restaurant.
That's the best pizza in town. What about Zoe?
Zoe is bringing juice. Orange and apple, two big bottles.
And Liam?
Liam is bringing fruit. His mum says we should eat something healthy, so he's cutting up apples and bananas.
And Grace? Is she making sandwiches again? They were lovely last time.
No, you're making the sandwiches this time, Dad! Grace is bringing biscuits. She made them herself yesterday.
Sandwiches. Right. I'd better go to the shop.

questions.explain: Ella is bringing popcorn——直接说了，她妈妈有爆米花机。
He wanted to bring ice cream, but there's no room in our fridge. So he's bringing a pizza——冰淇淋是干扰，最后带的是披萨。
Zoe is bringing juice——两大瓶橙汁和苹果汁。
Liam is bringing fruit——妈妈让带健康的，切好的苹果和香蕉。
Is she making sandwiches again? No… Grace is bringing biscuits——三明治是干扰（这次是爸爸做），Grace 带的是自己做的饼干。巧克力没人带。
